title: Sensor Tower estimates GTA VI pre-orders at about 10.31 million copies and more than $1 billion a week before its 19 Nov 2026 launch (Insider Gaming, GamesBeat, Destructoid, 11 Nov), up from 7.71 million / $750M+ on 3 Nov; third-party estimate, Take-Two gives no count; tops Cyberpunk 2077's 8 million pre-orders (CD Projekt, Dec 2020, 59% PC); India: PS Store India lists 12:00 am IST Thu 19 Nov, PS Store India Rs 5,999 Standard / Rs 7,499 Ultimate (Business Today, Digit); PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, no PC date announced
